notes: Trading tools for the member's own Nexus paper accounts, on their own opt-in tool list. Each tool calls one Nexus Trades API route with the member's Skylit API key. Arguments named like a path placeholder fill the path; on GET the rest go in the query string, on POST the rest are the JSON body. Hand-kept: scripts/sync.py --check fails when a tool and the spec disagree.

tools.name: nexus_capabilities
tools.title: Nexus trading capabilities
tools.description: What this key can trade in Nexus right now: asset classes, order types, futures contracts and accounts. Read only, it changes nothing. Call it before any order so you never have to guess.

tools.name: nexus_trades
tools.title: List Nexus trades
tools.description: Your Nexus paper options and stock trades. Read only. Filter by status and page with limit and offset. With test: true it lists your test log (your 10 newest test orders) instead.

test.description: true lists your test log instead of your trades.

tools.name: nexus_trade
tools.title: Read a Nexus trade
tools.description: One of your Nexus paper options or stock trades, with its exits. Read only. Works with a test order's id too.

id.description: The trade's id, from nexus_open_trade or nexus_trades.

tools.name: nexus_open_trade
tools.title: Open a Nexus paper trade
tools.description: Places a PAPER trade on the user's own Nexus account. Options and stocks go to their Nexus paper wallet; futures go to their practice account, or to an evaluation or funded account named in account. Nothing is sent to a broker. The server prices the fill from the live market when the call arrives. A real order counts like one placed by hand: it shows in their trades, stats and ranks, and unless the trade is private, people who copy their trades get it too. Send test: true first: the order is checked and priced like a real one, then kept in the test log and never placed. Confirm the order with the user before sending test: false. Always make up a clientOrderId and reuse it if you retry, so a retry can't place a second order. Options are bought to open at market. Call nexus_capabilities first.

assetClass.description: Which book the order goes to.

contract.description: Options shorthand, like SPY 600C 10/16. Send this, or ticker, strike, direction and expiration.

ticker.description: A symbol like SPY. For futures, a product like NQ (the front month) or one contract like NQZ26.

side.description: Stocks and futures. Options are always bought to open.

quantity.description: Options 1 to 1,000 contracts, stocks 1 to 100,000 shares, futures 1 to 100 contracts.

price.description: Options and stocks: a fill price the user got elsewhere, taken only inside a small window around the live quote.

ifOutside.description: When price is outside the window: refuse, or fill at market.

orderType.description: Options and stocks take market only. Futures also take limit (with limitPrice) and stop (with stopPrice).

limitPrice.description: Futures limit orders: the price the order rests at.

stopPrice.description: Futures stop orders: the price that triggers it.

stopLoss.description: Futures: a stop loss placed with the entry.

takeProfit.description: Futures: a take profit placed with the entry.

trailingStop.description: Futures: the stop loss trails the price. Needs stopLoss.

reduceOnly.description: Futures: only take contracts off a position the user holds, never open, add or flip.

account.description: Futures: practice (the default), evaluation, funded, or an account id from nexus_capabilities.

clientOrderId.description: Your own id for this order. Reuse the same one on a retry: you get the first order back and nothing new is placed.

test.description: true checks and prices the order, then keeps it in the test log instead of placing it. Use it for the first call.

tools.name: nexus_exit_trade
tools.title: Trim or close a Nexus paper trade
tools.description: Sells some or all of one of the user's Nexus PAPER options or stock trades at market. Nothing is sent to a broker. Send quantity to trim, or closeAll: true to close what's left, not both. A test trade's exit is always a test, so rehearse with a test trade first. Confirm with the user before exiting a real trade. Always make up a clientOrderId and reuse it if you retry.

id.description: The trade's id, from nexus_open_trade or nexus_trades.

price.description: A fill price the user got elsewhere, taken only inside a small window around the live quote.

ifOutside.description: When price is outside the window: refuse, or fill at market.

clientOrderId.description: Your own id for this exit. Reuse the same one on a retry.

test.description: Optional. The trade decides: a test trade's exit is always a test.

tools.name: nexus_futures_account
tools.title: Read a Nexus futures account
tools.description: Balance, open positions and loss rules for one of the user's Nexus paper futures accounts. Read only.

account.description: practice, evaluation or funded (when exactly one is running), or an account id from nexus_capabilities.

tools.name: nexus_futures_orders
tools.title: Nexus futures order history
tools.description: Order and fill history for one of the user's Nexus paper futures accounts, newest first. Read only.

account.description: practice, evaluation, funded, or an account id.

before.description: Only orders placed before this time, like 2026-10-09T14:00:00Z.

tools.name: nexus_futures_close
tools.title: Close or flatten Nexus paper futures
tools.description: Closes one futures position, or flattens the whole account, at market on the user's Nexus PAPER futures account. Nothing is sent to a broker. Send ticker or closeAll: true, not both. test: true previews the close against what the account really holds and places nothing. Confirm with the user before a real close. Always make up a clientOrderId and reuse it if you retry.

account.description: practice, evaluation, funded, or an account id.

ticker.description: The position to close, like NQ or NQZ26.

closeAll.description: true flattens every position in the account.

clientOrderId.description: Your own id for this close. Reuse the same one on a retry.

test.description: true previews the close and places nothing.

tools.name: nexus_futures_working_orders
tools.title: Resting Nexus futures orders
tools.description: Limit, stop and bracket orders resting on one of the user's Nexus paper futures accounts. Read only.

account.description: practice, evaluation, funded, or an account id.

tools.name: nexus_futures_order
tools.title: Read a Nexus futures order
tools.description: One order on one of the user's Nexus paper futures accounts. Read only.

account.description: practice, evaluation, funded, or an account id.

orderId.description: The order's id, from nexus_open_trade, nexus_futures_working_orders or nexus_futures_orders.

tools.name: nexus_futures_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel a resting Nexus futures order
tools.description: Cancels one resting order on the user's Nexus PAPER futures account. Nothing is sent to a broker. With test: true it acts on a test order in the test log only, never a real one. Confirm with the user before cancelling a real order.

account.description: practice, evaluation, funded, or an account id.

test.description: true acts on a test order in the test log only.

tools.name: nexus_futures_modify_order
tools.title: Move a resting Nexus futures order
tools.description: Moves the price of one resting order on the user's Nexus PAPER futures account. Nothing is sent to a broker. Size can't change: cancel and place a new order for that. Test orders can't be moved, so there's no test mode here. Read the order with nexus_futures_order first and confirm the new price with the user.

account.description: practice, evaluation, funded, or an account id.

tools.name: nexus_futures_cancel_orders
tools.title: Cancel resting Nexus futures orders
tools.description: Cancels every resting order on the user's Nexus PAPER futures account, or just one contract's orders. Nothing is sent to a broker. Send cancelAll: true or ticker, not both. With test: true it cancels the account's test orders in the test log only. Confirm with the user before cancelling real orders.

account.description: practice, evaluation, funded, or an account id.

cancelAll.description: true cancels every resting order on the account.

ticker.description: Cancel only this contract's orders, like NQ.

test.description: true cancels the account's test orders in the test log only.
